stories.headline: GTA 6 is 6 days away.
stories.body: Launch is <mark>November 19</mark> on <mark>PS5</mark>, with a <mark>rolling midnight release</mark> country by country. <mark>Pre-loading opened November 10</mark> on the PlayStation Store, so you can download it ahead of time and be ready the second it unlocks.

stories.headline: Nvidia's CEO just quit.
stories.body: <mark>Jensen Huang resigned</mark> as CEO of the chip giant on Thursday. CFO <mark>Colette Kress</mark> is <mark>interim CEO</mark>. Shares fell <mark>about 4%</mark> to a <mark>52-week low</mark> and are <mark>down 20% in November</mark>, while rivals <mark>AMD and Broadcom</mark> rose over 5%.

stories.headline: Anthropic wants $64 billion.
stories.body: The AI company launched its <mark>IPO roadshow</mark>: <mark>825 million shares</mark> at <mark>$70 to $78</mark> on Nasdaq under <mark>ticker ANT</mark>. At the top of that range it would raise <mark>up to $64.35B</mark>. Reported dates: <mark>pricing Nov 18, trading Nov 19</mark>, not yet official.

stories.headline: Sony is shutting down its PC streaming app.
stories.body: The <mark>PlayStation Plus PC app</mark> shuts down <mark>December 10</mark>. Sony says <mark>fewer than 0.4%</mark> of eligible Premium members used it. It let subscribers <mark>stream console games</mark> to a PC, so that option disappears.
